subject: Not able to install RHipe on Ubuntu

messages.author: c867e9e04b34de54
messages.subject: Not able to install RHipe on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi All,

I have installed Hadoop v0.20. , R and protobuf-2.4.1 on my Ubuntu OS.

I am getting below error while installing Rhipe -

sudo R CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.54.tar.gz

>>>
g++ -I/usr/share/R/include -fpic -O3 -pipe -g -I. -g -
DHAVE_UINTPTR_T `pkg-config --cflags protobuf` -Wall -c display.cc -o
display.o
In file included from ream.h:7:0,
from display.cc:1:
./rexp.pb.h:16:2: error: #error This file was generated by an older
version of protoc which is
./rexp.pb.h:17:2: error: #error incompatible with your Protocol Buffer
headers. Please
./rexp.pb.h:18:2: error: #error regenerate this file with a newer
version of protoc.
display.cc: In function ‘int32_t readJavaInt(FILE*)’:
display.cc:240:33: warning: ignoring return value of ‘size_t
fread(void*, size_t, size_t, FILE*)’, declared with attribute
warn_unused_result
make: *** [display.o] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘Rhipe’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rhipe’

Can anybody help me on this?


Thanks
Pariksheet

Try this

http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhipe/download/Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz

0.54 is quite old.

What version of protocol buffers do you have? The newer RHIPE requires PB 2.4.1
